title: PayRecoverPolicyDecision
description: Authoritative structured policy decision produced by the reasoning layer and consumed by the deterministic execution pipeline.

decision_id.description: Unique deterministic or random UUID for this decision instance.

action.description: The exact selected candidate action from the canonical recovery action contract.

reason_codes.description: Standardized reason codes explaining why this action was selected (e.g. ['temporary_gateway_failure', 'high_predicted_uplift']).

expected_recovery_amount.description: Expected recovered revenue in INR (Probability of Recovery * Transaction Amount).

expected_cost.description: Expected direct and indirect intervention costs in INR.

confidence.description: Model confidence score in the predicted recovery probability.

policy_version.description: Version string of the active merchant policy ruleset (e.g. 'v1.4.0').

model_version.description: Version/identifier of the model/reasoner that generated this recommendation (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash-2026' or 'uplift-t-learner-v2').

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was generated.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which this decision becomes stale and MUST be rejected if unexecuted.
